notes.title: Voice Acting Update For Our Zombie Game
notes.notes:
We just released the full voice acting update for Scheming Through The Zombie Apocalypse.
Check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/813540/Scheming_Through_The_Zombie_Apocalypse_The_Beginning/
